# finbar✶studio

> finbar✶studio is a boutique web development studio in Brisbane, Australia, run by
> Finbar Skitini. Custom-designed and custom-coded websites, backed by years of brand
> and graphic design, for businesses across Australia and the UK.

Services: web design and development (custom-coded front ends with a CMS clients run
themselves), brand identity and logo design, editorial and print, motion graphics and
social content, art direction.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.finbar.studio/): studio overview and recent website builds
- [Web design & development](https://www.finbar.studio/web-design): the web service page — capabilities, selected web projects, FAQ
- [Graphic design](https://www.finbar.studio/graphic-design): brand, editorial, print and motion work
- [Selected work](https://www.finbar.studio/work): the full portfolio archive with case studies
- [About & contact](https://www.finbar.studio/about): who Finbar is, services, clients, and how to get in touch

## Contact

- Email: finbar@finbar.studio
- Location: Brisbane, QLD, Australia (clients across Australia and the UK)
